stickers.name: 4 → F
stickers.description: In Korea 4 sounds like "death" - lifts show F instead.

stickers.name: Any → 3
stickers.description: Lucky in Korea - third time lucky, as they say.

stickers.name: Any → 8
stickers.description: In Chinese 8 sounds like "get rich" - very lucky.

stickers.name: Any → 7
stickers.description: Lucky 7 of the West - lucky for all on star night.
stickers.descriptionKo: 서양의 행운의 숫자 7. 별의 밤엔 모두의 행운!

stickers.name: Any → 6
stickers.descriptionKo: 중국에선 일이 술술 풀리는 수. 신부님에겐 666!

stickers.name: Any → 13
stickers.description: Lucky in Italy, feared in the rest of the West.
stickers.descriptionKo: 이탈리아에선 행운, 다른 서양에선 불길한 수.

stickers.name: Ginseng tea
stickers.description: A warm cup calms the queue. Works all of tomorrow.
stickers.descriptionKo: 따뜻한 차에 손님 마음이 느긋해져요. 내일 하루.

stickers.name: Elevator tune-up
stickers.description: Fresh oil: car and doors move faster all tomorrow.
stickers.descriptionKo: 기름칠로 엘리베이터와 문이 빨라져요. 내일 하루.

stickers.name: Good-luck talisman
stickers.description: A paper charm against bad luck. Works tomorrow, once.
stickers.descriptionKo: 액운을 막는 종이 부적. 내일 첫 불길만 막아요.

stickers.name: Maneki-neko
stickers.description: Japan's beckoning cat calls in money, all tomorrow.
stickers.descriptionKo: 손님과 돈을 부르는 일본 고양이. 내일 하루.
